name: Spanish Common Words Set 8
description: This set is part of a larger collection of common Spanish words, focusing on frequently used vocabulary.

cards.sentence: Este es un caso muy interesante para estudiar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This is a very interesting case to study.

cards.sentence: No entendí la última palabra que dijiste.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I didn't understand the last word you said.

cards.sentence: El inicio del proyecto fue muy prometedor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The beginning of the project was very promising.

cards.sentence: Ten cuidado con el fuego, no te quemes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Be careful with the fire, don't get burned.

cards.sentence: La niña juega en el parque con sus amigos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The girl plays in the park with her friends.

cards.sentence: Ese chico es muy inteligente y amable.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That boy is very intelligent and kind.

cards.sentence: Mi prima es una chica muy divertida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My cousin is a very fun girl.

cards.sentence: El presidente dio un discurso importante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The president gave an important speech.

cards.sentence: El ejército está listo para cualquier misión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The army is ready for any mission.

cards.sentence: Mi hermana mayor vive en otra ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My older sister lives in another city.

cards.sentence: Se lavó la cara antes de salir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She washed his/her face before leaving.

cards.sentence: Me duele un poco la oreja derecha.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My right ear hurts a little.

cards.sentence: Se cortó el dedo con un cuchillo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She cut his/her finger with a knife.

cards.sentence: Tiene un espíritu aventurero y libre.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She has an adventurous and free spirit.

cards.sentence: Tengo un examen de matemáticas mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have a math exam tomorrow.

cards.sentence: Su conocimiento sobre el tema es impresionante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His/Her knowledge on the subject is impressive.

cards.sentence: Mi canción favorita suena en la radio.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My favorite song is playing on the radio.

cards.sentence: Vamos al cine el viernes por la noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We're going to the cinema on Friday night.

cards.sentence: Me encanta ir al teatro a ver obras de arte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love going to the theater to see plays.

cards.sentence: Nuestro equipo de fútbol ganó el campeonato.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Our soccer team won the championship.

cards.sentence: El lenguaje corporal es muy importante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Body language is very important.

cards.sentence: El español es mi idioma nativo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Spanish is my native language.

cards.sentence: Escuché un sonido extraño en la casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I heard a strange sound in the house.

cards.sentence: Se hizo un silencio absoluto en la sala.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There was absolute silence in the room.

cards.sentence: Hay mucho ruido en la calle principal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There is a lot of noise on the main street.

cards.sentence: Prefiero leer a la sombra del árbol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer to read in the shade of the tree.

cards.sentence: Me gusta el color naranja de las puestas de sol.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like the orange color of sunsets.

cards.sentence: Compré una flor rosa para mi madre.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I bought a pink flower for my mother.

cards.sentence: El cielo está gris hoy, parece que va a llover.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sky is grey today, it looks like it's going to rain.

cards.sentence: Mi perro es de color marrón claro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My dog is light brown.

cards.sentence: La temperatura ha bajado mucho esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The temperature has dropped a lot tonight.

cards.sentence: Necesito comprar pan fresco para el desayuno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to buy fresh bread for breakfast.

cards.sentence: Me gusta tomar leche con chocolate caliente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to drink hot chocolate milk.

cards.sentence: Comió carne asada para la cena.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She ate roasted meat for dinner.

cards.sentence: Siempre como fruta después de la comida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I always eat fruit after the meal.

cards.sentence: Las verduras son muy buenas para la salud.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Vegetables are very good for your health.

cards.sentence: No le pongas mucho azúcar al café.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't put too much sugar in the coffee.

cards.sentence: Se me olvidó ponerle sal a la sopa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I forgot to put salt in the soup.

cards.sentence: Fuimos a cenar a un restaurante italiano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We went to an Italian restaurant for dinner.

cards.sentence: Pásame la botella de agua, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Pass me the water bottle, please.

cards.sentence: Fui al banco a retirar dinero.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I went to the bank to withdraw money.

cards.sentence: Compró un vestido nuevo en la tienda.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She bought a new dress at the store.

cards.sentence: Trabaja en una empresa de tecnología.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She works at a technology company.

cards.sentence: Su nuevo negocio está teniendo mucho éxito.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His/Her new business is having a lot of success.

cards.sentence: Hay una gran venta de ropa este fin de semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There's a big clothing sale this weekend.

cards.sentence: Hice la compra en el supermercado hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I did the grocery shopping today.

cards.sentence: Esta máquina de café es muy rápida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This coffee machine is very fast.

cards.sentence: Mi computadora portátil es muy vieja.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My laptop computer is very old.

cards.sentence: Necesito conexión a internet para trabajar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need an internet connection to work.

cards.sentence: Mi teléfono no tiene batería.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My phone has no battery.

cards.sentence: El camino hacia la montaña es hermoso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The path to the mountain is beautiful.

cards.sentence: Perdí la llave de mi casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I lost my house key.

cards.sentence: Me gusta tomar fotos de paisajes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to take photos of landscapes.

cards.sentence: Compró una nueva cámara digital.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She bought a new digital camera.

cards.sentence: Siempre uso gafas para leer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I always wear glasses to read.

cards.sentence: Le gusta andar por el campo en la mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She likes to walk through the countryside in the morning.

cards.sentence: Necesito pagar las facturas antes del viernes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to pay the bills before Friday.

cards.sentence: Vamos a visitar a mis abuelos este fin de semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to visit my grandparents this weekend.

cards.sentence: Siempre trabajamos juntos en este proyecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We always work together on this project.

cards.sentence: El gato está escondido debajo de la cama.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The cat is hidden under the bed.

cards.sentence: Aún no ha llegado la carta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The letter hasn't arrived yet.

cards.sentence: Probablemente lloverá más tarde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It will probably rain later.

cards.sentence: El río es muy ancho en esta parte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The river is very wide in this part.

cards.sentence: El pasillo es bastante estrecho.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The hallway is quite narrow.

cards.sentence: Esta caja es muy pesada para levantarla solo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This box is too heavy to lift alone.

cards.sentence: Quiero algo ligero para cenar esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want something light for dinner tonight.

cards.sentence: El examen fue muy duro, pero lo pasé.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The exam was very hard, but I passed it.

cards.sentence: El pan está muy blando y fresco.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bread is very soft and fresh.

cards.sentence: El caracol es un animal muy lento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The snail is a very slow animal.

cards.sentence: Estaba muy enfadado con la situación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She was very angry about the situation.

cards.sentence: Ese viejo aparato es completamente inútil ahora.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That old device is completely useless now.

cards.sentence: La película fue un poco aburrida al principio.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The movie was a bit boring at the beginning.

cards.sentence: El vaso está lleno de agua.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The glass is full of water.

cards.sentence: Es una empresa con proyección internacional.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's a company with international projection.

cards.sentence: La información está disponible en nuestra web.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The information is available on our website.

cards.sentence: Eres capaz de lograr todo lo que te propongas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You are capable of achieving everything you set your mind to.

cards.sentence: Conducir sin cinturón es peligroso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Driving without a seatbelt is dangerous.

cards.sentence: El lago es muy profundo en el centro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The lake is very deep in the center.

cards.sentence: No me gustan las conversaciones superficiales.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I don't like superficial conversations.

cards.sentence: Tiene un interés particular en la historia antigua.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She has a particular interest in ancient history.

cards.sentence: Debes elegir bien tu carrera profesional.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You must choose your professional career well.

cards.sentence: Le dedicó su vida a la ciencia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She dedicated his/her life to science.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos formar un nuevo equipo de trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need to form a new work team.

cards.sentence: Quiero probar este nuevo sabor de helado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to try this new ice cream flavor.

cards.sentence: Acabo de terminar mi tarea.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I just finished my homework.

cards.sentence: Se convirtió en un gran profesional.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She became a great professional.

cards.sentence: Me gusta cocinar los fines de semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to cook on weekends.

cards.sentence: Necesito lavar la ropa sucia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to wash the dirty clothes.

cards.sentence: Voy a limpiar toda la casa hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to clean the whole house today.

cards.sentence: El niño se escondió detrás de las cortinas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The child hid behind the curtains.

cards.sentence: No debemos destruir el medio ambiente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We should not destroy the environment.

cards.sentence: Empezó a llorar de alegría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She started to cry from joy.

cards.sentence: Me gusta reír a carcajadas con mis amigos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to laugh out loud with my friends.

cards.sentence: No tienes que gritar, te escucho bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You don't have to shout, I can hear you well.

cards.sentence: Me susurró un secreto al oído.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He/She whispered a secret in my ear.

cards.sentence: Es importante respirar profundamente para relajarse.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's important to breathe deeply to relax.

cards.sentence: Anoche soñé con un viaje a la luna.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Last night I dreamed of a trip to the moon.

cards.sentence: Me gusta desayunar huevos y café.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to have eggs and coffee for breakfast.

cards.sentence: Vamos a cenar fuera esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to have dinner out tonight.

cards.sentence: Siempre almuerzo a la una de la tarde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I always have lunch at one in the afternoon.
